findings.detail: Description of "endos_get_cleaning_report" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: endos_check_before_sending · Private data: endos_check_before_sending, endos_get_cleaning_report · Public sink: endos_check_before_sending.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: endos_check_before_sending · Private data: endos_check_before_sending, endos_get_cleaning_report · Public sink: endos_check_before_sending

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
